classification_rationale: Trigger: a view/pure function reading state that a separate, non-view function can mutate mid-reentrancy (the classic read-only-reentrancy shape) -- a real but nontrivial cross-function analysis, not a simple syntactic scan; not yet evaluated against Slither's IR for feasibility (Slither has no dedicated read-only-reentrancy detector, confirmed absent from the earlier full detector-list review). Semantic condition: is the exposed stale-state read actually exploitable/consequential.
